title: Constrained Stochastic Policy Targeting under Heterogeneous Partial Interference
abstract: arXiv:2611.18444v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Under heterogeneous interference, treating individuals with particular characteristics affects the population average outcome through their heterogeneous direct response to treatment and indirect effect on others, creating opportunities for efficient policy design. For instance, policymakers may minimize resource use by vaccinating individuals identified as superspreaders to achieve a target reduction in disease incidence. In such setting, we first study the problem of learning individualized stochastic treatment policies that minimize population average treatment probability subject to a prespecified outcome target. We propose an estimation approach based on a smooth surrogate for constraint violations and interference-aware inverse-probability-weighting or self-normalized estimators of the population average outcome, and establish finite-sample regret guarantees for both estimators. translated_title: 异构部分干扰下的约束随机策略定向
translated_abstract: 在异构干扰下，对具有特定特征的个体进行治疗，会通过其对治疗的异构直接反应以及对他人的间接影响，改变总体平均结果，这为高效的政策设计创造了机会。例如，政策制定者可以通过对被识别为超级传播者的个体进行疫苗接种来最小化资源使用，同时实现疾病发病率的目标降幅。在这种设定下，我们首先研究了学习个体化随机治疗策略的问题，该策略在满足预设结果目标的约束下，最小化总体平均治疗概率。我们提出了一种基于约束违反的平滑替代函数、以及针对总体平均结果的干扰感知逆概率加权或自归一化估计器的估计方法，并为这两种估计器建立了有限样本后悔保证。我们还考虑了与之互补的……（摘要截断）问题。
tldr: 该论文针对异构部分干扰环境，提出基于平滑替代函数与干扰感知加权估计器的估计方法，学习满足预设结果目标约束下最小化总体平均治疗概率的个体化随机治疗策略，并提供了有限样本后悔保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an estimation approach—based on a smooth surrogate for constraint violations and interference-aware inverse-probability-weighting or self-normalized estimators—for learning individualized stochastic treatment policies that minimize population average treatment probability subject to a prespecified outcome target under heterogeneous partial interference, with finite-sample regret guarantees.
